title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Humphreys Concerts By The Bay, San Diego | 2003
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at Humphreys Concerts By The Bay in San Diego, California, USA, on 7 September 2003.

It was the final show by the eighth All-Starr Band. Their tour of North America lasted for 35 dates between July and September 2003.

Starr had previously performed at Humphreys Concerts By The Bay on 16 August 1995, 4 May 1997, and 25 and 26 June 2000. He returned there on 29 June 2006, 27 July 2008, 6 August 2010, 19 July 2012, 11 July 2014, 1 July 2016, 27 September 2018, 28 and 31 May 2023, 7 September 2024, and 29 May 2026.

The eighth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Paul Carrack: vocals, guitar, keyboards
  • John Waite: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, percussion, guitar, bass, harmonica, flute
  • Sheila E: vocals, drums, percussion
